verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device inference SDK and CLI, so exposing low-level engine settings is a fair axis to judge. The evidence pack documents no way to override memory locking, mmap or similar engine parameters. The integrations docs instead stress that there is "nothing to configure by hand," which points to opinionated defaults rather than power-user overrides.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can override low-level engine settings like memory locking or mmap behavior instead of being limited to opinionated defaults
